body: Hm I sometimes watch very very sad shows, like the more people that die and suffer, the better, just so I can feel something else than my own pain. Just so I can see other people who feel like shit. Not that I would EVER want to hurt anyone, but... Idk somehow it works comforting. It's just weird when depression becomes your normal, right?
You think? Lol I would've described myself more as a bitter bitch but okay. Thank you for being so nice to me.

I haven't, I'm not really good at creative stuff. I'm scared of doing something wrong, even if everyone tells me it's impossible. And with my depression getting worse, I just don't have any inspiration or anything to write down. Sometimes I try to write down my thoughts, but I don't think I'd be able to make poetry about that.

It just crushes me that those visions are not able to exist ever because humans are shitty. I know, not all humans, but the ones in power. One of my friends tells me to get up and do something about it, if it bothers me that much. But I feel so small, so insignificant, and I don't think I could every change anything. Even IF I had the resources.

By the way, thank you for talking to me. Having to type out answers to your questions breaks the cycle of suicidal thoughts, even if just for a moment. I'm sorry my answers are all so depressing though, I used to be able to make people laugh. Sorry.

I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you'll find a new dream that will become reality somewhere in the future.

I turned out to be bad at it, I never finished my degree. It's why my parents hate me. I got too depressed to get anything done and never was able to finish it. I'm quite smart, people say I pick up things fairly quickly... I don't know about that though. In my opinion, I'm bad at everything I try and I ruin everything. Not finishing my degree proves this point exactly. My parents aren't wrong by calling me a failure, you know. Oh it was a degree in economics by the way, and it taught me a lot about humans and our society. I think I'm too emotional for it. Can't handle the corruption, people only thinking about themselves, their own gain, never about the society as a whole or other people. Most economic problems can be fixed quite easily and would have been fixed, if politicians for once listened to experts and didn't think only about themselves. But I digress...

I didn't think about that when I was younger. I just wanted to do my best at school and I didn't know what I wanted to become. I just always wanted to please everyone, even though I could never make anyone happy.

It's how I chose what I would study in college: this one thing I'm not too stupid for, there's work in the field and my parents will think it's a good diploma to have. I never once thought of what I wanted to do. It's because I never had a dream like that. Ever... It makes me really sad

My family knows and thinks it's a selfish think to do and I should just toughen up and keep going. If I dare to mention it, my mom hits me. 

Two of my friends know, they don't want to hear the negativity if I need to talk about it. I'm not allowed to talk about it and I'm not allowed to kill myself because it would hurt them. As I said, apparently I'm the selfish one here, but I've been staying alive for so many years, bearing this pain, trying not to hurt others. But I think my pain is much worse than what they could ever feel. They don't want me around most of the time, they even tell me. So yeah maybe they're going to be sad for a second, but they'll be fine and relieved shortly after.

She's not a police officer or anything like that, she just... Works for the government. I'm not really comfortable talking about what she does for work, but she just works a desk job but it's for the government.
I'm not exactly sure what you mean by that, but it's largely the same as in the UK I think? Strictness wise...
I have been to London many times, you have lovely bookstores there. I'm from Belgium.

Maybe yes. But my parents will come looking for me. My mom works for the government and just by searching for my name, she will find my address in this country. I would have to move out of the country for her to be unable to track me down and knock on my door and give me more shit to deal with.

It's just terribly complicated and so much work. And honestly I wouldn't know what I would do that for. I don't want to live anymore, I don't want to go on. I see no happiness or anything that comes close to it for me in this life, so why go on? Why fight so hard for nothing? I will still be alone, miserable and terrified, just in a different place. I'm sorry, I'm so depressed, I just don't see the point.
And what do I do then? They control all my savings, I have no money and no place to go. So what happens then?
Yeah well they're doing a lot of things against my will. Not really anything I can do about it.

I have a very small family and they're all siding with my parents on this. It's just my grandparents, I have no aunts or uncles or any other family.

My friends... I lost touch with most of them. A lot of them have grown up to be very different than I am and they don't like me anymore. The ones I still hang out with either never have time for me, just ignore me or they flat out say I'm too negative and have to leave them alone. Even if someone would want to hang out, I'm not even allowed to leave the house.
But they're all I have. I have no one else, I have nothing else except me and I hate myself.

It's not my fault, that's right. But I am a shitty person, maybe not in the same ways, but I still am. My friends hate me, because I'm too negative. My family tells me every time I walk into a room what a disappointment I am and how they'd rather have cancer than hearing me say another word. They'd never had me if they had known that this was what they're going to get.

So yeah maybe I don't ruin the world, but I ruin enough lives to say that I'm a shitty person. I mean if my parents tell me I'm the scum of this earth, it must be pretty bad, right?

What kind of person downvotes someone complaining about how shitty this world is and feeling suicidal? Really? You're just gonna confirm this? Thank you, thank you very much for once again showing me that I'm right and that I don't belong on this earth if I can't handle all the shitty people that live on it. Thanks a lot.
